title: How much faster in percentage is the champion than the driver who finished
question:
How much faster in percentage is the champion than the driver who finished the race last in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: how much faster in percentage = divide(subtract(incremental time, champion time), last_driver time) * 100; last driver finished time = incremental time + champion time; only champion's finished time is represented by 'HH:MM:SS.mmm'; finished the game refers to time is not null

prediction.sql: SELECT ((CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 7) AS REAL)) + CAST(SUBSTRING(last.XCL_084, 2) AS REAL)) / ((CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(champ.XCL_084, 7) AS REAL))) * 100 AS percentage_faster FROM results AS "champ" JOIN races AS "r" ON "champ".XCL_074 = "r".XCL_065 JOIN results AS "last" ON "last".XCL_074 = "r".XCL_065 WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.XCL_066 = 2008 AND champ.XCL_079 = 1 AND last.XCL_079 = (SELECT MAX(res2.XCL_079) FROM results AS res2 WHERE res2.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065 AND NOT res2.XCL_084 IS NULL)

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  (
    (CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600
     + CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60
     + CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 7) AS REAL))
    + CAST(SUBSTR(last.XCL_084, 2) AS REAL)
  )
  /
  (
    (CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600
     + CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60
     + CAST(SUBSTR(champ.XCL_084, 7) AS REAL))
  )
  * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM results champ
JOIN races r ON champ.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN results last ON last.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND r.XCL_066 = 2008
  AND champ.XCL_079 = 1
  AND last.XCL_079 = (
    SELECT MAX(res2.XCL_079)
    FROM results res2
    WHERE res2.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
      AND res2.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
  )
